text: 1.Master's degree or equivalent or above with good marks. 2.Aged under 45 3.At least two recommendations of experts whose professional title is above professor; 4.Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
